_doc: Plain wording for rotation lines whose condition the humaniser (rotation.py) can only read out clause by clause. Keyed by that text; the card's tooltip keeps the exact rule. build_data.py warns about a code-like condition with no entry here, and about entries no line uses.

when.((Mana Tide Totem is ready and mana unde: Clearcasting is not up and the mana, counting Mana Tide Totem's 1160 while it is ready, won't last the rest of the fight at 20 a second
when.(4+ combo points and (Slice and Dice is: 4+ combo points while Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ Energy or in the last 6s of the fight. In the last 3s, any combo points
when.(5+ combo points and (Slice and Dice is: 5 combo points while Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ Energy or in the last 6s of the fight. In the last 3s, any combo points
when.(any combo points and Slice and Dice is: Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 1s left with over 9s of the fight left
Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 3s left with over 9s of the fight left

Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 3s left with over 9s of the fight left, or when Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry is ready and waiting for it

Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 3s left with over 9s of the fight left, or when Adrenaline Rush is ready and waiting for it
when.(the next melee swing or Raptor Strike i: A melee weave fits before the next Auto Shot, Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot, but the swing or Raptor Strike won't be ready on arrival, or mana is under 25 per second of fight left
A melee weave fits before the next Auto Shot, Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot, but the swing or Raptor Strike won't be ready on arrival
when.(within 0.25s after a main-hand swing or: Within 0.25s after a main-hand swing, or in the last 6s of the fight. While Vanish is ready, only at 4+ combo points, with Slice and Dice down, or in the last 10s
when.5+ combo points and enough Energy for Ev: 5 combo points, the Energy for Eviscerate and over 6s of Slice and Dice, unless the points are going to a Slice and Dice for Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry
5 combo points, the Energy for Eviscerate and over 6s of Slice and Dice, unless the points are going to a Slice and Dice for Adrenaline Rush
5 combo points, the Energy for Eviscerate and over 8s of Slice and Dice, unless the points are going to a Slice and Dice for Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry
when.At least 10 mana per second of fight lef: At least 10 mana per second of fight left, when no melee weave fits before the next Auto Shot, Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot, or when Sniper Shot's cast and the run in both fit before the next melee swing
when.At least 30% mana and next main-hand swi: Light's Vigil is not on the boss, the next main-hand swing is over 2.5s away, and there is mana to spare: at least 60%, or at least 30% with enough mana, counting the Major Mana Potions and Demonic Runes left, to last the fight at 55 a second (75 a second once the boss is under 20% health or 10s from it)
when.Light's Vigil on the boss or under 30% m: Light's Vigil is on the boss, or Light's Vigil can't go: under 30% mana, the next main-hand swing within 2.5s, or too little mana to spare for it
when.No Bane of Doom on the boss and no Bane: Neither Bane on the boss, over 12s of the fight left, and Bane of Doom over 12s from ready or the fight in its last 60s
when.Recklessness is not up and (no more Reck: Recklessness is neither up nor due within 15s
when.Shadowmeld is ready and behind the boss: Shadowmeld is ready, behind the boss and under 5 combo points, on Clearcasting or in the last 10s of the fight with the Energy for Ravage
when.The global cooldown is ready and (no Imm: The global cooldown is ready, Immolate is missing or has under 1.5s left, over 4s of the fight left, and Conflagrate is ready within 5s
when.[[tal:Mage:0:10|Arcane Blast]] talent ta: [[tal:Mage:0:10|Arcane Blast]] talent taken, under 2 stacks of Arcane Blast with none up or over 9s left on them, and over 4s of the fight left
when.[[tal:Mage:1:11|Heating Up]] talent take: [[tal:Mage:1:11|Heating Up]] talent taken and Heating Up at 3+ stacks, except while Fingers of Frost is up and Pyroblast casts in under 1.49s
when.[[tal:Mage:1:9|Improved Scorch]] talent: [[tal:Mage:1:9|Improved Scorch]] talent taken and Fire Vulnerability under 5 stacks or with under 7s left. While Fingers of Frost is up and Scorch casts in under 1.49s, only under 5 stacks or with under 4s left
when.[[tal:Mage:2:15|Fingers of Frost]] talen: [[tal:Mage:2:15|Fingers of Frost]] talent taken and 1 Fingers of Frost charge left, while Scorch takes 1.49s or more to cast or a Frostfire Bolt is in flight
